findings.detail: The cash-equivalent row US BANK MMDA GCTS is included in the nonaccrual artifact even though its source tickmarks are (9)(14)(15), not the non-accrual tickmark seen on debt rows.
The artifact population includes prior-period schedule variants such as December 2024 cash-equivalent rows, so the 2025 report-date nonaccrual population is not limited to current-period source rows.

rationale: Raw source confirms a true non-accrual aggregate at September 30, 2025 (table 81 row 4: amortized cost 21,125,453 and fair value 1,991,208), and representative debt rows carrying tickmark (16) support that some positions are non-accrual. However, the artifact also tags US BANK MMDA GCTS as non-accrual even though its source row is a cash equivalent with tickmarks (9)(14)(15), not (16). That is a source-grounded over-classification of non-accrual status rather than a mere warning about genuine non-accrual loans.
